title: atriplex canescens subsp. macropoda
intro: Atriplex canescens subsp. macropoda, commonly known as Big Sagebrush, is a type of shrub that belongs to the Amaranthaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and aiding in wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Big Sagebrush include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These constituents work together to provide a range of health benefits, making Big Sagebrush a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
